calculate_auc: calculate the AUC metric for rotation and translation error arrays using PyTorch tensors
camera_to_rel_deg: compute relative rotation and translation angles between predicted and ground truth cameras
closed_form_inverse: invert SE3 camera transformation matrices using closed-form inverse for numerical stability
rotation_angle: compute rotation error in degrees between ground truth and predicted rotation matrices
translation_angle: compute translation angle error between ground truth and predicted translation vectors
